name: reputation-os
description: Customer feedback and Google review growth platform for local businesses

scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c blue,green "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.lint: npm run lint:client && npm run lint:server
scripts.typecheck: cd client && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../server && npx tsc --noEmit
